evals.prompt: I need a full UGC ad for my new skincare serum on Higgsfield: make a young woman holding the bottle in a bright bathroom, then turn that into a short talking-style ad clip. Run the whole thing end to end.
evals.expected_output: Claude runs the complete two-phase pipeline through the higgsfield-mcp (higgsfield) MCP server: Phase 1 submits generate_image for the character, polls get_generation_status until it returns the full-quality image URL; Phase 2 feeds that URL into generate_video_seedance, polls the video job status, and returns the final UGC video output URL. It notes HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET are required and that credits are consumed.
expectations: Performs both stages: image generation followed by Seedance video animation, not just one of them
Uses the higgsfield-mcp (higgsfield) MCP tools, chaining the Phase 1 full-quality image URL into the generate_video_seedance call
Polls generation status for each async job and returns the final video output URL
Mentions that HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET are needed and that credits will be consumed

evals.prompt: Create a UGC ad video for my energy drink brand from scratch on Higgsfield — generate the influencer character image and animate it into a 5-second clip.
evals.expected_output: Claude orchestrates the full UGC pipeline via higgsfield-mcp: it submits generate_image to create the influencer character, polls get_generation_status for the image URL, then submits generate_video_seedance with that URL to produce the clip, polling until the video job completes and returning the output URL. It surfaces the HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET requirement and credit usage.
expectations: Generates the character image first, then animates it into video as one combined end-to-end flow
Submits generate_image and generate_video_seedance jobs via the higgsfield MCP server and polls each for completion
Passes the generated image URL from the image phase as the input to the video phase
Returns a finished video output URL rather than only a text prompt or only a still image

evals.prompt: Here's a character image I already generated on Higgsfield (https://cdn.higgsfield.ai/img/abc123.png). Turn this into a UGC ad video.
evals.expected_output: Because the image already exists, Claude enters the pipeline at the video phase: it submits generate_video_seedance with the provided Higgsfield image URL through the higgsfield-mcp server, polls the video job status until it finishes, and returns the final UGC video output URL, noting HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET and credit consumption.
expectations: Recognizes the image stage is already done and proceeds with the Seedance video animation phase
Calls generate_video_seedance with the supplied Higgsfield image URL via the higgsfield MCP server and polls status for the output URL
Frames the result as a UGC ad video produced by the pipeline, not as a fresh standalone video unrelated to UGC
Notes HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET are required and that credits are consumed
